items.title: This fix made things worse. Good.
items.caption:
One of our test fixes made things worse. I think that's the most useful thing the product does.

Two ad sets were merged. Most tools would stop at "applied". Adspenta, the marketing tool I'm building for agencies, keeps watching every change it sends: day 7, then day 14, against the account's own baseline. This one came back "worse".

Four honest answers: improved, worse, no change, not enough data. You hear it first, not your client.

Would you rather know, or not know?

items.caption:

items.title: Four say applied. One didn't land.
items.caption:
Four changes. All say "applied". One never actually happened.

That gap between what a tool says and what the platform holds is why Adspenta, the marketing tool I'm building for agencies, reads every change it sends back from Meta and Google. Only a match counts as confirmed. No match, and it says unconfirmed, not done. Then day 14 tells you if it worked.

Have you ever found a change that never landed?
